puzzles.title: Back-rank mate with rook
puzzles.hint: Use the open file to reach the eighth rank.
puzzles.explanation: The rook delivers checkmate on e8 because the black king is trapped behind its own pawns.

puzzles.title: Back-rank mate with queen
puzzles.hint: The eighth rank is undefended.
puzzles.explanation: Queen to d8 checkmates because the black king cannot escape the back rank.

puzzles.title: Mate in one
puzzles.hint: Find a move that leaves the opposing king with no escape.
puzzles.explanation: The solution delivers checkmate in a single move.

puzzles.title: Mate in two
puzzles.hint: Force a position where mate cannot be avoided next move.
puzzles.explanation: After the forcing move, every defense allows mate on the following turn.
